entries.name: Pikachu
entries.label: Bonuses — Sunday — Normal
entries.source_text: Look for spooky surprises left by mischievous Pokemon in the wild. Tap them for a chance to receive event-themed Pokemon encounters, Pikachu Candy, Zubat Candy, Sinistea Candy, or, if you're lucky, Rare Candy!
